An [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] '''blockade''' was active during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]] under the command of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Boyse/Legends|Boyse]] from his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Exchequer/Legends|''Exchequer'']]. The [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] was meant to ensure that the [[Core Five/Legends|Council of Five]], the leaders of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], not issue loans and provide funds to enemies of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Endless" />

==Behind the scenes==
The blockade was mentioned in ''[[Endless Vigil]]'', a [[2016]] sourcebook for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'' [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="Endless" />
